doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Treasury Share Purchase via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
doc_title_jp: 自己株式の取得及び自己株式立会外買付取引（ToSTNeT-3）による自己株式の買付けに関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率の向上及び株主還元の充実、機動的な資本政策の遂行

summary_en: 175,000 shares (13.1% of shares outstanding) acquired at ¥4,950/share via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-19; ¥866.25M upper limit; execution within single trading session; primary shareholder Mitsubishi Electric may sell holdings concurrently.
summary_jp: 2026-08-19 ToSTNeT-3にて175,000株（S/O 13.1%）を¥4,950/株で買付；上限¥866.25M；単一取引セッション内で実行；筆頭株主三菱電機が同時売却の可能性。
